description: This source file manages the version mapping for operator upgraders in PyTorch's JIT compiler, including sorting and updating version entries, and flags related to version calculation.

methods.name: get_operator_version_map
methods.description: Returns the map of operator names to their upgrader entries, sorting them if necessary.

methods.name: calculate_package_version_based_on_upgraders
methods.description: Sets the flag to determine if package version should be calculated based on upgraders.

methods.name: get_version_calculator_flag
methods.description: Returns the current state of the version calculator flag.
